summary: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a public offering of $4.75 billion aggregate principal amount of senior notes in four tranches: $1.25 billion 4.600% notes due 2029, $1.50 billion 5.000% notes due 2031, $1.00 billion 5.250% notes due 2033, and $1.00 billion 5.500% notes due 2036. The notes were sold to underwriters (Barclays, BofA, Citi, JPMorgan, Morgan Stanley, Wells Fargo) at prices from 99.757% to 99.921% of par. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes, possibly debt repayment. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
